pages.title: Combining Conditions
pages.content: Logical operators combine multiple conditions: `and` (both must be true), `or` (at least one must be true), `not` (reverses the result). These are written as English words in Python.

pages.title: And, Or, Not
pages.code:
age = 25
has_license = True

# and - both must be True
print(age >= 18 and has_license)  # True

# or - at least one True
print(age < 18 or has_license)    # True

# not - flips the value
print(not has_license)             # False

pages.title: Logical Operators
pages.text: The [blank] operator returns True only if both conditions are True.
